 A Load Tap Changer (LTC) - Power Station - Vacuum Bottle Oil Immersed - OLTC, also known as an on-load tap changer, is a crucial component in power plants. It is an oil immersed vacuum bottle with contacts that can change the turns ratio of a transformer on-load. The LTC tank and oil contain the internal components such as the motor, drive gear, or chain, oil immersed vacuum bottle with contacts, limit switches, wiring, and other related instruments, alarms, and gauges. In terms of maintenance, it is important to note that all work on the LTC and the transformer should be treated as a single maintainable unit. This approach ensures that all necessary maintenance tasks are performed in a coordinated and efficient manner, reducing the risk of errors and improving overall system reliability.

Instruments, alarms, and gauges directly associated with the LTC should also be regularly tested and calibrated to ensure that they are providing accurate and reliable readings. This includes checking for any signs of wear or damage, and ensuring that the instruments are set up and calibrated correctly.

Finally, it is important to ensure that all personnel working on the LTC and transformer are properly trained and qualified to do so. This includes providing them with the necessary safety training and ensuring that they have the appropriate skills and knowledge to perform the required maintenance tasks.
